method: Independent second-author cross-review of all 121 exact existing Spec proposals, read with the selected English source sense/hash and every retained Spanish semantic sense in three batches of 31 and a final batch of 28. Approval accepts the unchanged proposed meaningIndex, record hash, frame, profile and context; only aspectModes may be restricted to the stated subset. Prior different choices remain archival and their notes are not imported. This is original model linguistic judgment, not source-membership-only approval, native-human certification or a rendered-word coverage claim. Ordinary permits source-supported human agents/operators/patients and genuine personal figuratives; entity-only selected contexts require it-only rather than invented human personification. Mandatory pronominal substitutions, incompatible subject roles and resultative/middle-slot failures are withheld. Ordinary context-supplied trailing complements and grammatical word-level fragments are not rejected merely for lacking a full example sentence. Exact hyphenated/base frames remain subject to existing verified inflection guards; no qualified English past/participle override is supplied. No application/source edits or publication.
